div.div: أُسْطُولٌ A ship of war, prepared for fighting with. the unbelievers on the sea: mentioned by El-Makreezee in the “ Khitat; ” and he says, “ I do not think this word to be [genuine] Arabic: ” (TA:) [it is evidently from the Greek στόλο� :] several writers mention it among arabicized words. (MF, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
